results.name: Diagonal Chop Right
instructions: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and simultaneously bring your hands diagonally across your body towards your right hip, bending your knees slightly as you turn.
Keep your arms extended and pivot your right foot as you rotate to protect your knee from strain.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, bringing your hands back opposite your chest.
tips: Engage your core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and enhance power.
Pivot on your feet during the rotation to ensure a full range of motion and to reduce stress on your knees.
Focus on exhaling as you chop down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to aid in balance and prevent strain on your joints.
results.description: Diagonal Chop Right is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Arms.

results.name: Dragonfly
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and grasp a stable support. Extend your legs straight together and hold them just above the floor.
Engage your core and lift both legs upward while rolling your hips off the floor until your body is supported on your shoulders.
Slowly lower your hips back to the floor, then continue lowering your straight legs until they are just above the floor without touching it.
Repeat the movement with controlled, continuous motion while keeping your legs together and as straight as possible.
tips: Keep your legs together throughout the entire movement.
Lift your hips by engaging your core rather than using momentum.
Lower your legs slowly to maintain tension in your abdominal muscles.
Inhale as you lower your legs and exhale as you lift them upward.
results.description: Dragonfly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Ab Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell with both hands straight over your chest.
Lift your head, shoulders, and upper back off the floor by contracting your abdominal muscles.
Raise the dumbbell towards the ceiling as you perform the crunch, keeping your arms straight. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position, keeping control of the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to avoid straining it.
Avoid using your neck muscles to lift your head; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Breathe out as you lift your upper body and breathe in as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Ab Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Dumbbell Crunch Hold With Legs Off
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees straight and your legs lifted off the floor almost parallel to the floor, holding a dumbbell with both hands extended just over your hips.
Engage your core and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, performing a crunch while pushing the dumbbell over your thighs.
Hold the crunch position for a few seconds, ensuring your abs are fully engaged and your lower back remains pressed into the floor.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the floor, maintaining control of the dumbbell throughout the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe out as you lift your shoulders off the floor and inhale as you lower them back down.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the exercise for maximum effectiveness.
Start with a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase as you become more comfortable.
results.description: Dumbbell Crunch Hold With Legs Off is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit-Up
instructions: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured, holding a dumbbell in each hand extended overhead.
Slowly lift your shoulders, and upper back off the bench while simultaneously bringing the dumbbells up and over your head.
Continue to lift your torso until you are in an upright position with the dumbbell directly above your head.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, keeping the dumbbells extended overhead.
tips: Keep your neck in a neutral position to avoid strain.
Focus on a smooth and controlled motion to maximize core engagement.
Avoid using momentum to lift yourself; rely on your core muscles.
results.description: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet securely positioned under the footpads. Hold a dumbbell with both hands against your chest.
Lift your upper body towards your knees, keeping the dumbbell close to your chest.
Sit up fully until your back is straight, then slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position.
Repeat the exercise for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the dumbbell close to your chest throughout the exercise to maintain balance.
Focus on engaging your abdominal muscles, not using momentum.
Keep your head and neck in line with your spine to avoid strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Decline Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Dumbbell Diagonal Chop
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and lower the dumbbell diagonally across your body to the left side, extending your arms fully as you reach downward, while pivoting your feet towards your left side.
In a controlled motion, bring the dumbbell back up to the starting position, reversing the diagonal path.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Rotate your torso and pivot your feet to allow for a full range of motion.
Maintain a firm grip on the dumbbell to ensure control.
Perform the movement in a controlled manner to avoid swinging the dumbbell.
results.description: Dumbbell Diagonal Chop is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and feet stacked. Place your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell against your top hip with your upper hand.
Press your forearm into the floor and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Keep your shoulders and hips stacked while holding the dumbbell securely against your hip.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then lower your hips with control and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Maintain a straight line from your head to your feet without letting your hips drop.
Keep your shoulders and hips stacked without rotating forward or backward.
Engage your obliques and glutes to keep your pelvis lifted.
Inhale and exhale steadily throughout the hold without holding your breath.
results.description: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Begin in a half-kneeling position with your left foot forward and your right knee on the floor. Hold one dumbbell with both hands low beside your right hip.
Rotate your torso to the left and lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body.
Continue raising the dumbbell until your arms extend above your left shoulder.
Reverse the movement and lower the dumbbell back toward your right hip, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your front foot flat on the floor and right knee directly below your hip for stability.
Rotate through your torso while keeping your hips and lower body stable.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and avoid pulling the dumbbell with your biceps.
Exhale as you lift and rotate the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your feet stacked. Place your supporting hand directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell securely against your top hip.
Press through your supporting palm and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Keep your supporting arm straight and maintain your shoulders and hips stacked while holding the position.
Hold for the desired duration, then repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Place your supporting hand directly below your shoulder and spread your fingers for stability.
Keep your feet stacked and avoid rotating your hips forward or backward.
Engage your obliques and glutes to prevent your hips from dropping.
Inhale and exhale steadily throughout the hold.
results.description: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps, Glutes.
